content.short: A high-throughput Data Availability (DA) service built on EigenLayer, providing rollups with cheap, secure storage.
content.description:
EigenDA is a high-throughput Data Availability (DA) service built on EigenLayer. It is designed specifically for Ethereum rollups, allowing them to store transaction data efficiently and at a fraction of the cost compared to the mainnet. By leveraging the massive economic security of EigenLayer's restaking pool, EigenDA ensures that data remains accessible and secure while offering linear scalability as more operators join.

The service targets throughputs exceeding 10 MB/s, making it a cornerstone for scaling Ethereum. It provides the infrastructure for rollups to process millions of transactions without compromising on security or cost. Through its innovative architecture, EigenDA enables massive data throughput for next-generation dapps.
